frozen_note: Selection, class policy, threshold rule and tolerance rule were fixed and committed before the detector ran on any AOT frame. Changing any value here creates a new benchmark_id.

source.name: Airborne Object Tracking (AOT) dataset, training set
source.modality: 8-bit grayscale PNG, 2448 x 2048, about 10 fps, camera on an aircraft (moving platform)

cameras.note: From each part's groundtruth.json metadata 'description'. 716 flights appear in part3 (camera1) as well as in part1 or part2 (camera0), with different frames and timestamps.

class_policy.nominal_box_rule: An aircraft box whose larger side is at most 16 px and which has a side of exactly 6 or 16 px is a nominal marker, not an extent; the aircraft becomes an ignore region.

split.unit: capture day of the flight: UTC date of its earliest ground-truth timestamp over all its cameras, so both cameras of a flight always share a split
split.allocation: first floor(n/4) days holdout, next floor(n/2) - floor(n/4) days validation, remaining days development
split.holdout_policy: Sealed. Its frame list is frozen and hashed here, but its frames are not downloaded or evaluated before AERIS-018 release evaluation, and it never drives thresholds or model selection.

selection.sequence: a flight and a camera, sequence_id '<flight_id>-<camera>'
selection.sequence_order: days in ascending sha256(salt + day); within a day sequences in ascending sha256(salt + sequence_id); sequences taken round-robin over days until the split's count is reached
selection.candidate_frames: ground-truth frame numbers divisible by frame_stride

frame_kinds.scored: has at least one aircraft with a measured extent
frame_kinds.empty: has no labelled object at all
frame_kinds.other: has labelled objects but no measured-extent aircraft (nominal markers, unknown objects, birds)

selection.frame_order: ascending sha256(salt + sequence_id + ':' + frame) within each kind
selection.composition_note: Frames are chosen from labels only, never from model output. The mix is enriched for scored aircraft relative to the dataset's natural frame distribution, so AP and precision describe this composition, not an unweighted random frame.

detector.input_note: Grayscale PNGs are decoded with OpenCV IMREAD_COLOR (three equal channels), as the detector expects BGR.

evaluation.threshold_rule: On the validation split only: the score threshold with the highest F1 at IoU 0.5 on the grid 0.01, 0.02, ..., 0.99; ties go to the higher threshold. If no grid value gives a true positive, the threshold is null and the gate is blocked.

regression_rule.tolerance: For each gated metric: max(2 x the largest absolute difference observed between the baseline run and the repeat run, the metric's resolution floor). A candidate fails when it is worse than the baseline by more than the tolerance.

resolution_floor.ap_reason: COCO reports AP to three decimals; smaller differences are below reporting resolution.
resolution_floor.count_metric: one count: 1 / denominator (support, detections at threshold, or negative frames)
resolution_floor.count_metric_reason: A single object or detection changing state is the smallest real change on a fixed frame set.

regression_rule.support_rule: A width bin with fewer than 30 scored objects, or a negative-frame metric with fewer than 30 negative frames, is reported as not gated (unavailable), never as a pass.
regression_rule.interval_note: Day-bootstrap intervals are reported as context for what the set can resolve; they are not the tolerance.

budget.owner_decision: 2026-09-27: the owner asked for labelled data found online and approved more budget if needed. No paid compute.
